crossRefs.note: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”
If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will…
Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be…
He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…
I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of…
“I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who…

translations.web: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
translations.bsb: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
translations.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
translations.asv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
